skills.name: Soaring Strike (凌空一击)
skills.description: Taira no Maskado attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Temporal Shift (时隙轮转)
skills.description:
Exclusive effect. At the start of the battle, Taira no Masakado's starting ATK exceeds 700% DEF, enters Offensive Stance; otherwise enters Defensive Stance. Wields artifact Futsunomitama.
[Cast] Switches stance. ; : ;Offensive Stance (攻击架势) : :When casting Eternal Blazing Sun, enhances Futsunomitama once. ;Defensive Stance (防守架势) : : When attacked, recovers HP equal to 500% of starting DEF (up to 70% of starting ATK) and enhances Futsunomitama once (can be enhanced once per turn). ;Futsunomitama : :After every 3 enhancements, Taira no Masakado immediately enters Rift in Time. ;Transferred Damage :One of the types of damage, cannot crit, is due to some shikigami skills being able to distribute damage, such as Shouzu's link and Ushi no Toki's doll. ;Recover :Different from healing or restoring, cannot Crit, unaffected by reduced healing effects and does not trigger effects related to healing.

upgrades.text: After Rift in Time ends, reduces own duration of received debuffs and control effects by 1 turn.
While in Rift in Time, Eternal Blazing Sun's orb cost is reduced by 2.
Defensive Stance's recover effect also applies to other allies, with the amount equal to 70% of their own stats (does not trigger when affected by transferred damage).
While in Offensive Stance, each time Futsunomitama is enhanced, Eternal Blazing Sun's AoE multiplier increases by 5% (max 15%)

skills.name: Ever-burning Sun (骄阳长明)
skills.line: Halting the war with my might, no legion's power can compare to mine.
skills.description: Taira no Masakado attacks all enemies 3 times, dealing 64% ATK damage each hit. Then he deals ruin damage equal to 18% of total damage dealt to selected enemy. If an enemy is defeated, gains 3 orbs and strengthens Futsunomitama once. ;Ruin Damage :One of the types of damage, ignores DEF and damage reduction effects. ;Futsunomitama : :After every 3 enhancements, Taira no Masakado immediately enters Rift in Time.

upgrades.text: AoE damage increases to 80%; for each enemy shikigami defeated, Taira no Masakado receives 7% less damage and the ruin damage coefficient increases by 5% (up to 5 times.)
